profile.headline: Software Engineer at Superhuman
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as a software engineer on the Superhuman Desktop team, building the core app on desktop/web

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Led a team of three engineers working on Cameo’s public facing storefront systems, specifically the React/React Native front end browsing experience and the underlying Node API used to process and deliver content for those surfaces. My focus was on guiding overall architecture as these systems grew, coordinating and reviewing technical work, and collaborating with product and design to determine requirements and find the right paths forward for future projects.

- Outside of time spent managing/planning, I worked directly on implementing various technical improvements for the larger team, including improving page load speed across the site by splitting our code bundles, updating critical libraries such as React and Webpack, and optimizing our server side rendering processes to improve throughput.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed the first version of the company's NestJS + GraphQL backend, productionizing an earlier prototype to deploy for an early use case

- Contributed to several projects, including contributions to our cross platform React Native design system, and extensions to the Cameo CMS API.

- Led a working group of engineers in an initiative to update Cameo’s engineering interview process, creating a carefully tested set of interview questions and training documents, intended to reduce variance between interviewers, focus interviews on specific qualities, and improve the quality of post-interview feedback and discussion.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: - Built Cameo’s internal content management system, a MongoDB powered API designed to quickly and reliably serve dynamic pages across both web and native platforms. The system supports hand curated marketing changes alongside algorithmic customization, allowing Cameo to rapidly respond to marketing needs, seamlessly run A/B tests of content, and tailor the content served to an individual user’s interests.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Built/maintained the Civis Component Library, a curated collection of React components that can be easily shared across teams, reducing duplicated work and allowing for better design cohesion across the company’s products.

- Built version 1 of the Civis Research Library, a React/Redux/Flask app that visualizes arbitrary survey data for easy analysis by business users. My work centered around the front end, building out dynamic charts using Recharts, and implementing the data transformations needed to smoothly connect our API responses to the various app views.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed the Civis Flask Service, an internal repo providing a standard structure for building React/Redux apps with Flask APIs and Postgres databases. This structure has been adopted across several products/teams, and development has continued to coordinate improvements across those groups.

* Worked on Civis’s survey infrastructure, a Python codebase handling survey configuration, data imports, and automatic preparation of said data for analysis.

* Worked to refactor and enhance a multi platform mobile app, built in React Native with a Python Flask API, hosted on AWS and using a DynamoDB NoSQL database. Added unit testing and error logging to improve app maintainability and stability.

honors.title: Intern Innovation Challenge Winner
honors.description: Worked with a small team of fellow interns to develop an idea and presentation on technological innovations that could be harnessed to benefit Fidelity Investments. A panel of judges chose our presentation as the best of the 15 competing, and we then went on to give a more detailed version of the presentation to the Fidelity Chief Information Officer council for their consideration.

projects.title: Major Qualifying Project: Deep Learning
projects.description: Researching and implementing deep learning neural networks on the Assistments learning system. My team is developing a Theano based system in Python to run deep learning algorithms on the educational data collected by Assistments; and connecting the system to pre-established Java tools via a RESTful API in order to enable non-technical researchers to access and benefit from deep learning techniques.

projects.title: Interactive Qualifying Project: Data Mining
projects.description: Collaborated on an interdisciplinary team of four to aid the US Food and Drug Administration in expanding their use of data mining; through the creation of an accessible manual on data mining and its applications to FDA pharmacovigilance work. This required extensive research on Big Data and data mining, as well as thorough interviews with individuals within the FDA itself.

organizations.name: WPI Social Committee
organizations.description: Served in an elected leadership position overseeing the WPI Social Committee, a student organization that uses funding from the administration to plan large social events for students (concerts, film screenings, festivals, etc). I cooperated with other top executives to plan overall organization goals, manage sub-committees, mediate internal disputes, ensure appropriate usage of the club’s $200,000 budget, and guide the organization’s public image.
